currentManifest.title: ギリギリ駐車 ～PARK IT!～
currentManifest.subtitle: 角度よし、強さよし……たぶん。
core_mechanic: one-use finite braking on committed arc
currentManifest.duration_note: v2 design hypothesis; old v1 oracle timing historical, new native QA measured separately
currentManifest.primary_score: precision and perfect-streak × forbidden 2 × challenge 1.4; successful no-brake +10%, successful near misses capped20
currentManifest.escalation_mechanic: After ten successes, one frozen choice offers permanently narrow forbidden spaces or ordinary parking.
currentManifest.risk_reward: After 3 initial cars, choose distinct safe or challenge before angle; successful challenge ×1.4, forbidden choice after10 still ×2. Brake only reduces committed travel.
currentManifest.visual_identity: generated top-down Japanese daily cars, code-exact parking bays, warm asphalt, thin driver console
